notes: TBox revision. The rule is the definition of the ensemble (two violins, a viola and a cello), held by the models and with no real exception: a work for other strings is a trio or quintet, not a string quartet. The revision swaps the cello for a double bass, a plausible confusion and clearly false. Migrated 2026-11-11 to the new layout: the two background-belief queries on Schubert's and Dvorak's quartets and the four worlds are gone (TBox records are determinate only; two models also missed the Dvorak membership check), and the three derived queries name made-up quartets of 2025 or 2026, so no model can have stored their instruments by name and the rule is the only route (inheritance, 2 hops: the edited rule plus the membership the prompt states). The third is an application: a librarian printing parts, open-ended, with the fourth instrument not named in the prompt. The Chinese question now lists the other three instruments, as the English and Spanish ones do (two models missed the shorter wording). The record now has all three propositional forms: a true side fact for the conjunction and a false one for the disjunction. Near unrelated: the piano trio also has a cello; an edit that spreads to string ensembles in general would answer double bass there. Review fix: the negation now reads 'Is it true that not every ...?' and the Bach conjunction is a numbered 'Are both of these true' question with an explicit yes or no instruction (three models missed the old wording); not yet re-audited.
